company.name: Text Blaze
company.shortDescription: Personal workflow automation. Save programmable snippets and insert them anywhere on the web.
company.description:
Text Blaze is democratizing productivity. It allows users to save programmable text snippets and insert them anywhere on the web using keyboard shortcuts. 
Snippets can be plain text, but they can also include real-time input from the user, dynamic business logic, and no-code integrations with other apps.

productsAndServices.description: A tool to save text snippets and templates with shortcuts for insertion across web apps in Chrome and desktop apps.
